ed-end reads underwent quality control and trimming utilizing fastp (v0.23.0). De novo assembly of the filtered reads was executed using MEGAHIT (v1.1.2). Contigs were binned into metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) employing MetaBAT2 (v2.12.1) with default parameters. The quality of the MAGs was evaluated using CheckM2 (v2.0.1), retaining only high-quality MAGs with completeness >90% and contamination <5% for subsequent analysis.

The sludge samples utilized for metaproteomic analysis were identical to those described for metagenomics in Section 1.5, specifically the CK and MG samples collected at the end of Phases II and IV.
